analyst.summary: Surya Roshni's business, dominated by its steel pipes division, has been essentially stagnant for several years -- revenue is roughly flat and profit has actually declined over the past three years, reflecting the thin, commodity-price-sensitive margins typical of steel products. The one clear positive is the balance sheet: the company has paid down almost all of its debt over the past few years and offers a healthy, well-covered dividend. This looks like a low-growth, financially conservative holding rather than one with a fresh growth catalyst.
